findings.text: `unsetopt local_options nomatch` disables both `local_options` and `nomatch`, where the intent was to scope the change to this function (`setopt local_options nonomatch`). In zsh, running `nvm_list_aliases` (for example via `nvm ls`) permanently turns off `nomatch` in the user's interactive shell. It also turns off `local_options` for the function, so any option changes made later in the function leak out too. Failing input: run `nvm ls` in zsh, then `echo /nonexistent*` prints the literal pattern instead of a 'no matches found' error.
